Provides administrative support to the staff in Peri-Operative Services serving as a central point for communication and department liaison on matters related to all procedural area operations and activities. Responsibilities include: providing basic reception, answering telephone, typing, filing, etc. Will facilitate surgery scheduling by coordinating the needs with clinical staff and vendors, obtaining patient and financial clearances as needed. Maintains daily staff schedules, schedules meetings/events, generate reports. Tracks OR patient records and documentation. Required to float to all UCI Health locations as needed.
Required to float to all locations of UCI Health as needed
Working knowledge of operating room practices and surgical procedures; anatomy and medical terminology.
